## What does this PR change?

- [ ] Measurement data (`benchmarks/`) — complete the checklist below
- [ ] Correction to an existing conclusion (with reproducible evidence)
- [ ] New recipe / documentation improvement
- [ ] Tooling (`planner.py` / `config-generator.html`)

## If this contains measurement data

- [ ] Full server **and** client commands, verbatim (not "similar to")
- [ ] Hardware, clock policy, power limit
- [ ] Exact driver / CUDA / NCCL / framework / image tag versions
- [ ] At least 3 independent cold starts, variance reported (not just the best run)
- [ ] Input/output lengths and sampling parameters

## Evidence discipline

Every number added carries a basis tag (**Measured / Derivable / Open**) and a
source. **No number without a basis — an empty cell is worth more than a
fabricated one.**
